newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ March qtr GDP revised to 0.8 pct from 0.7.
newsitem.headline: NZ March qtr GDP revised to 0.8 pct from 0.7.

text.p: Statistics New Zealand said on Thursday it had revised the real seasonally adjusted production- based GDP rise in the March 1996 quarter to 0.8 percent from 0.7 percent.
Econonmists had said a substantial revision to the number could affect financial markets.
The June 1996 quarter figure was left unchanged at a rise of 0.3 percent and the growth rate in the September quarter was 0.6 percent.
Statistics New Zealand said the revision in the March quarter was the result of incorporating new annual information.
